facts.text: The PATHe program provides a transfer pathway for students to complete an Associate of Arts degree at St. Petersburg College and transition to USF's St. Petersburg campus.

sources.title: Explore Programs for Transfers | University of South Florida
sources.quote: PATHe is a pathway for students to earn an Associate of Arts degree at St. Petersburg College and then seamlessly transition to USF's St. Petersburg campus to earn their bachelor's degree.

facts.text: USF prioritizes on-campus housing assignments for incoming first-year and rising second-year students.

sources.title: Continuing Student Room Selection Process | Housing and Residential Education
sources.quote: To align with university-wide initiatives supporting students during their first two years, USF is prioritizing housing for incoming first-year students and rising second-year students.
